h: Vows Reach the Hidden Source of the Life of Kingship

p: וַיְדַבֵּר מֹשֶׁה אֶל רָאשֵׁי הַמַּטּוֹת וְגוֹ׳
"And Moshe spoke to the heads of the tribes, etc."
"What does it teach when it says
It tells that the release of vows is only
Now this needs to be understood:
all of the Sanhedrin were experts;
so why specifically the heads of the tribes,
that the Ramban on this parsha
"What is the difference between vows and oaths?
like one who vows by the life of the King;
like one who swears by the King Himself;
a hint to the matter, etc."
וְכָתַב עַל זֶה הָרַמְבַּ״ן זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה
And the Ramban, of blessed memory, wrote on this:
that the oath (shevuah) is from the word 'seven'
she has hewn out her seven pillars' (Mishlei 9:1);
and the vow is in Tevunah:
קֶדֶם מִפְעָלָיו מֵאָז וְכוּלֵּי (מִשְׁלֵי ח, כב)
before His works of old, etc.'" (Mishlei 8:22).
the Vav indicates the six attributes,
the aspect of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah.
and he wrote that this is what is said (Chagigah 10a):
"The release of vows floats in the air"
why the Ramban, of blessed memory, cited
the pasuk "the beginning of His way,"
that the vow is in Binah.
that the Shabbos meals are counted
בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (יִתְרוֹ, זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב פח, א)
in the holy Zohar (Yisro, Zohar II 88a)
and in the Ra'aya Mehemna (there, II 92a)
three holinesses of Shabbos are counted:
and the Shabbos of the night.
Now, "of the day" and "of the night"
are: "of the day" — the Holy One, blessed be He,
the aspects of the Field of apples and Ze'ir Anpin;
the attribute of day and the attribute of night
(זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב קיח, ב וְשָׁם צב, ב)
And this is because Atika Kadisha
is in truth the intellect hidden
and there is no grasp of it at all,
except through the aspect of Daas,
of the fifty gates of Binah;
through the joining of Chochmah and Binah
and Daas is the inner aspect from Kesser Elyon.
is as is written in the Tikkunim
(at the end of the book, end of Tikkun 5):
from the side of Abba and Imma,
כִּי יִפָּלֵא מִמְּךָ דָבָר (דְּבָרִים יז, ח)
'If a matter is too wondrous for you' (Devarim 17:8);
בְּמוּפְלָא מִמְּךָ אַל תִּדְרוֹשׁ (חֲגִיגָה יג, א)
'What is too wondrous for you, do not expound'" (Chagigah 13a).
And this is because Alef has the letters of "pele" (wonder).
And this is what is said,
"the release of vows floats in the air";
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בְּסֵפֶר יְצִירָה
based on what is written in Sefer Yetzirah:
for air was created with the letter Alef,
And this is what is written in the Sifrei,
"like one who vows by the life of the King,"
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בְּפֶתַח אֵלִיָּהוּ
along the lines of what is written in Pesach Eliyahu (Tikkunei Zohar, introduction):
כֶּתֶר עֶלְיוֹן אִיהוּ כֶּתֶר מַלְכוּת וְכוּלֵּי
"Kesser Elyon is the crown of Malchus, etc.;
is like the soul to the body,
which is life to the body";
and this is "the life of the King"
life to the aspect of Tiferes, the body.
And there is support for our words
מִמַּה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בְּסֵפֶר לְבוּשׁ אוֹר יְקָרוֹת
from what is written in the book Levush Or Yekaros
"that the vow is outside His structure;
and she vowed a vow' (Shmuel I 1:10-11),"
depend on the holy Mazal, etc."
which is above the letters of Havayah,
and the upper tip of the Yud
and this is the hidden Atika,
the inner aspect from Kesser Elyon,
And this is what he says in the name of "some say,"
that the vow is from Chochmah,
for all of the first three
are called by the term Atika.
the pasuk "the beginning of His way":
which is the intellect hidden from all thought,
in which "and He said" is not stated;
and it says "before His works of old"
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
based on what is written in the holy Zohar
and shone to every side, etc.,
וְזֶהוּ מַה שֶּׁאָמַר (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה ו, א)
And this is what is said (Rosh Hashanah 6a):
One who says, 'It is upon me' (alai)"
And this is the meaning of
"one who vows by the life of the King"
And this is why the verse says here
and this is based on what we find
(רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא בְּהַר, זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קט, ב, וְעוֹד)
(Ra'aya Mehemna, Behar, Zohar III 109b, and elsewhere),
and it lists: princes of Yisrael,
the wise, the understanding, the pious,
and it lists the princes of Yisrael
for they are the heads of the tribes,
And this is why the release of vows was made dependent
on the heads of the tribes,
